channel.description: Parts for the MP4 and MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros

item.g:title: Service Filter Kit – 5 Filters for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473
item.g:description: Everything for a standard oil service in one box: engine oil filter, fuel filter kit, fuel pre-filter / water separator, engine air filter and cabin pollen filter. $20 less than buying them separately.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Engine Oil Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 472 184 04 25
item.g:description: Engine oil filter element for the OM471 / OM473. Change at every oil service. Replaces OE A 472 184 04 25, A 472 184 05 25, A 472 180 03 09, A 472 180 01 09, A 473 180 00 09. Cross-reference: MAHLE OX 832D, MANN HU 12 001 z, Hengst E510H07 D129, Luber-finer LP5090, Baldwin P7505, Bosch F 026 407 192, Wix 57909, Donaldson P551005, Fleetguard LF17511.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Fuel Filter Kit for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 471 090 27 55
item.g:description: Main fuel filter kit for the OM471 / OM473: filter element, small mesh pre-strainer and O-rings. Keeps dirt out of the injection system. Change at every service. Replaces OE A 471 090 27 55, A 471 090 24 55. Cross-reference: MAHLE KX 581KIT, MANN PU 12 002-2 z, Hengst E445KP D314-2.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Engine Air Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 004 094 69 04
item.g:description: Engine air filter element. Check at every service and replace when the restriction indicator shows. Replaces OE A 004 094 69 04, A 004 094 68 04. Cross-reference: MAHLE LX 5437, MANN C 50 004/1, Hengst E2059L.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Cabin Pollen Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 960 830 02 18
item.g:description: Cab pollen filter for the heater and air conditioning on the MP4 / MP5 cab. Replace yearly or when airflow drops. A carbon version (A 960 830 01 18) is also fitted to some trucks, so send us your VIN if unsure. Replaces OE A 960 830 02 18. Cross-reference: MAHLE LA 1006.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: AdBlue Pump Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5
item.g:description: AdBlue (urea) pump filter. A blocked filter can trigger an emissions warning and power loss.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Fuel Pre-filter / Water Separator for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 960 477 00 03
item.g:description: Spin-on fuel pre-filter / water separator can for the OM471 / OM473, supplied with a new O-ring. Traps water and coarse dirt before the main fuel filter. Change at every service and drain water as needed. Replaces OE A 960 477 00 03. Cross-reference: MAHLE KC 505D, MANN PL 420/7 x, Hengst H356WK.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Power Steering Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5
item.g:description: Power steering hydraulic filter. Replace when changing steering fluid.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Air Dryer Cartridge for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 000 429 20 97
item.g:description: Spin-on air dryer cartridge with oil separator for the air processing unit on the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros. Keeps water and oil out of the brake air system. Change it every 1 to 2 years, or sooner if you're draining water from the tanks. Check your old cartridge has the M41 x 2 thread before you order, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit. New stock is on its way. Replaces OE A 000 429 20 97, A 000 429 21 97, A 000 429 37 95. Cross-reference: Knorr-Bremse K163455, MANN TB 1394/8 x, Mahle AL 35, febi 106249, Hengst T380W, Haldex 31005509.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Brake Hose Set with M22 Connectors for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 002 420 93 48
item.g:description: Brake hose (OE A 002 420 93 48) supplied as a set with 2 brass push-in connectors (OE A 000 997 81 34, M22x1.5 thread, with seals), ready to fit. Replaces OE A 002 420 93 48, A 000 997 81 34.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Front Brake Pad Set (Axle Set) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 006 420 14 20
item.g:description: Front axle brake pad set for the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros with Knorr-Bremse SM7 disc brakes. 4 pads, enough to do both front wheels. Front and rear pads are different sizes, so check the WVA number on your old pad (29246 or 29247) before you order, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit. If your old pads say WVA 29315 you have Wabco MAXX22L calipers and these won't fit. New stock is on its way. Replaces OE A 006 420 14 20, A 006 420 52 20, A 000 421 72 10. Cross-reference: WVA 29246, WVA 29247, Knorr-Bremse SM7.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Rear Brake Pad Set (Axle Set) for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 006 420 53 20
item.g:description: Rear axle brake pad set for the MP4 Mercedes-Benz Actros with Knorr-Bremse SL7 disc brakes. 4 pads, enough to do both wheels on one rear axle (order 2 sets for a tandem drive). Front and rear pads are different sizes, so check the WVA number on your old pad (29244 or 29245) before you order, or send us your VIN and we'll confirm fit. If your old pads say WVA 29315 you have Wabco MAXX22L calipers and these won't fit. New stock is on its way. Replaces OE A 006 420 53 20, A 006 420 15 20. Cross-reference: WVA 29244, WVA 29245, Knorr-Bremse SL7.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts
